measures_info.insideLeg: Measure the internal distance of the leg from the pubis to the soles of the feet.
measures_info.fullBodyLength: Measure the distance from your shoulders to the floor.
measures_info.waistUpper: Measure the waist circumference above your belly button.
measures_info.insoleLength: Place a sheet of paper on the floor against a wall. Stand with your heel on the paper and the wall. Mark the tip of your longest toe, then measure the distance.
measures_info.biceps: Outline the tape measure at the middle of your arm, identifying the widest part of it.
measures_info.height: This is an easy one. It is the distance between the top of your head (skull) to the ground (soles), measured with an upright posture.
measures_info.width: Take the measure of the width of your clothing
measures_info.sleeve: With your arm slightly bent, measure the distance between the shoulder and the wrist by passing the tape behind the elbow.
measures_info.neck: Outline the average height of your neck with a tape measure without squeezing it. Use a mirror to assist in checking the measurement.
measures_info.collar: Measure around your neck just above your collar bone, putting one finger between the tape and your neck.
measures_info.chest: Outline your chest or chest (breast area) with a tape measure and breathe normally. Notice the variations as you breathe and record the highest number.
measures_info.circumference: Take the measure of the circumference of your clothing
measures_info.length_botton: Position the beginning of the tape measure at the highest point on your body where the clothing will be. Release the rest of the tape and mark the measurement.
measures_info.waist: Place yourself in front of a mirror with your waist clearly visible. Slightly tilting the torso to the side, visualize the formation of a crease, which indicates the position of the natural waist. Wrap the waist.
measures_info.footLength: Stand on a flat surface, with your height aligned with the wall. Measure the longest part of the foot (from heel to toes) using a ruler.
measures_info.lowerLength: This is the distance between your hip to the floor.
measures_info.chest_m: Outline your chest with a tape measure and breathe normally. Notice the variations as you breathe and record the highest number.
measures_info.chest_f: Outline the bust (breast area) with a tape measure and breathe normally. Notice the variations as you breathe and record the highest number.
measures_info.palm: Place a ruler on a flat surface, flex your hand, place the left side of your dominant hand at the ruler's zero point and take note of your hand span.
measures_info.waistLower: Measure the waist circumference below your navel, where the waistband (low waist) usually fits.
measures_info.thigh: Outline the measuring tape around the widest part of your thigh, located just below the buttocks.
measures_info.underBust: Measure your chest with the tape measure around the area just below your bust. Breathe normally by noticing the variations in measurements and record the highest number.
measures_info.bar: Take the measure of the hem of your clothing
measures_info.insoleWidth: Remove the insole of a shoe that fits you well and measure the width of the insole as shown in the image.
measures_info.headCircumference: Measure the circumference of your head (above your ears) with the tape measure.
measures_info.wrist: Outline the measuring tape around your wrist, exactly where you would put a watch, for example.
measures_info.hip: Outline with the tape measure the "wider" region below the waist, running parallel to the highest part of the glutes.
measures_info.diameter: Measure the diameter of the inside circle of a ring that you wear on the same finger from the same hand where you want to wear this product
measures_info.length: Measure the distance between the upper part of your torso (junction with your neck) and your low waist (just below your belly) around your belly.
measures_info.fist: Outline the measuring tape around your wrist, exactly where you would put a watch, for example.
measures_info.calf: Sit on a chair and keep your foot on the ground, folding your leg to 90 degrees. With the tape measure on the side of the calf, take the measurement from the base of the foot to the fold of the knee.
measures_info.shoulderWidth: With the help of another person, measure the distance between the ends of your shoulders as shown.
measures_info.ring: Tie a thin string around the same finger that you want to wear this product, mark the junction of the string and measure the length to get the circumference
measures_info.centralSeam: Sitting on a flat surface, measure the distance between your waist and the surface with a tape measure

data_protection.title: How does SIZEBAY protect its data?
data_protection.text:
SIZEBAY considers the confidentiality and security of the information of its customers, users and visitors extremely important; therefore, it uses Encryption and Firewall technology, and will do everything in its power to ensure the protection of your data and information.

We recommend that you periodically clean the cookies stored in the browser you use, in order to prevent the information collected from being deleted from the SIZEBAY database, as well as from other websites accessed.

users_obligations.title: What are the user's obligations?
users_obligations.text: Application users undertake to use SIZEBAY’s services always respecting and observing the Policies, as well as current legislation, customs, public order, and the mandatory requirements required to use and accept the platform.

data_collected.title: What data is collected by SIZEBAY?
data_collected.text:
To provide its services, SIZEBAY may collect profile data such as nickname (optional), age, gender, height, weight, anatomical profile and body measurements. In addition, access log data and cookie data may be collected, in order to improve the user experience and ease the use of the application, without needing to provide again data already informed by the user in case of another purchase or analysis of product.

SIZEBAY will also be able to collect data from the purchase order made at the e-commerce, in order to analyze the recommended size and the actually purchased size, this to improve the services available for the size recommendation of clothing and shoes.

We clarify that the SIZEBAY application is concerned with the privacy of its users, thus, the services were developed in such a way that data collection is carried out without being possible to identify the data owners.

how_it_works.title: How does the access to the Virtual Fitting Room and Fit & Size Chart works?
how_it_works.text:
To use the services it is not necessary for the user to register on the SIZEBAY platform. Access to the Fit & Size Chart will be available and to use the virtual fitting room it is necessary for the user to fill in some basic information for the application to make the clothing and shoe size recommendation.

Creating a profile in the SIZEBAY application does not require the user to use their first or last name, and may even fill in fictitious data, if they are interested in further preserving their privacy.

Minors will not be able to use the application unless they are represented and/or assisted by their parents or guardians.

file.title: Instructions for printing and setting up the tape measure
file.how-to-do:
Print:
Before printing, make sure that the “fit to page” option in the printing dialog box is disabled so that the printer does not reduce or increase the dimensions of the tape.

Crop:
Using scissors or a stylus, cut out all the continuous black lines indicated with the "scissors" to create the segments of the tape.

Assembly:
Fold and rotate the ends (as indicated on the print) by joining the dotted lines until a single tape is assembled.

Fix the folds:
After assembly, fix the folds of the tape using glue, adhesive tape or a stapler.
